text:
Sam: Hi team — first-week networking oddity. Using company WireGuard profile from home (macOS 13). Internal services are reachable via bastion but direct internal IPs (10.4.x.x) time out. anyone seen host-route / split-tunnel weirdness?
Irene: @Sam can you paste `wg` output and `netstat -rn` or `route -n`? quick guess: host-route not being pushed or replaced by OS resolver.
Sam: sure — pasted below:
```
$ wg show
interface: wg-redwood
  public key: AAAA...bbb
  private key: (hidden)
  listening port: 51820
  peer: ZZZZ...yyy
    endpoint: vpn.redwood.company:51820
    allowed ips: 10.4.0.0/16, 172.19.0.0/16
$ netstat -rn
Destination        Gateway            Netif Expire
default            192.168.1.1        en0
10.4.0.0/16        link#14            utun2
172.19.0.0/16      link#14            utun2
```
Sam: but curl http://10.4.12.34:8080 just hangs, while `ssh -J bastionsvc@bastion.redwood 10.4.12.34` works fine.
devops-bot: Note: Your client IP was assigned 10.4.8.22, policy: split-tunnel, pushed-routes: 10.4.0.0/16.
Irene: interesting — kernel route exists. Could be firewall on the host interface (macpf) or MTU/fragmentation causing TCP stall on direct path but SSH proxied over bastion works since it's different path. try `curl --interface 10.4.8.22 -v http://10.4.12.34:8080` and `sudo ifconfig utun2 mtu 1350`.
Maria: also check DNS — some services are FQDN-only and redirect to internal loadbalancer that rejects external src. But since you're on split-tunnel it should be fine. If you can reproduce with `curl --interface` that's helpful.
Sam: ran both: `curl --interface` times out immediately. Lowering MTU to 1350 made `curl` respond with 502 from internal LB. hmm progress.
Irene: ok that points to PMTU. For a longer fix we push `mtu 1350` via config or set `PostUp` on WireGuard:
```
PostUp = /sbin/ifconfig %i mtu 1350
PostDown = /sbin/ifconfig %i mtu 1500
```
Irene: If you're on macOS and using the official profile, I can add a tag to your profile to set mtu. ping me DM with your onboarding ticket so I can update.
Tony: Heads-up — for new hires we usually recommend switching to the dedicated bastion SSH jump for service access until infra pushes a client-side tweak. Saves time during onboarding.
Sam: cool — what's the onboarding ticket tag look like?
Irene: ticket: ONB-4827. tell support to add `wg-mtu-1350` to your user config. I'll open a patch to default WireGuard MTU for home clients.
Sam: thx all! once patched I'll test and report back. :thumbsup:
Maria: welcome again Sam! ping me if you need access to internal SSO or KMS, I can fast-track.
Sam: will do — thanks everyone.
